newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS DULL SESSION MIXED ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS DULL SESSION MIXED ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed mixed against hard currencies after a lacklustre interbank foreign exchange session on Monday, dealers said.
"By the look of things nothing of significance happened today. It was a dead market," one dealer commented.

He said the local unit finished the day at 10.8150/8300 against the key U.S. dollar, its closing position for last Friday, but was quoted firmer against pound sterling at 18.2830/3130 compared to 18.3200/3400, tracking the U.S. dollar's gains overseas.
It also firmed to 6.9040/9120 against the mark from 7.0200/0400 but was softer on South Africa's rand at 2.2970/3030 against 2.2900/3100 at the previous close.
